_comment: Golden apply_patch envelopes. 'want' mirrors codex.PatchSummary; 'malformed' means ParseApplyPatch returns an error alongside the partial summary.

rows.name: single update
rows.envelope:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: a.go
@@
-x
+y
*** End Patch

rows.name: update add delete
rows.envelope:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: a.go
@@ func f()
 context
-old1
-old2
+new1
@@
-old3
+new2
*** Add File: b.go
+line1
+line2
*** Delete File: c.go
*** End Patch

rows.name: move
rows.envelope:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: old/name.go
*** Move to: new/name.go
@@
-a
+b
*** End Patch

rows.name: crlf and spaces in path
rows.envelope:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File:   dir with space/a b.go  
@@
-x
+y
*** End Patch

rows.name: same file twice is one target
rows.envelope:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: a.go
+1
*** Update File: a.go
+2
*** End Patch

rows.name: absolute and windows paths
rows.envelope:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /tmp/x.txt
+hi
*** Update File: C:\repo\a.go
-a
+b
*** End Patch

rows.name: lines before begin and after end are ignored
rows.envelope:
apply_patch <<'EOF'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: a.go
+x
*** End Patch
EOF
*** Update File: ignored.go
